conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Reference-voltage finite difference","Capacitor-current feedforward","Voltage-error feedback","Inductor-current reference summation","Reference-current finite difference","Inductor-resistance compensation","Current-error feedback","Control-voltage summation"],"inputs":["r[k]=v_out_REF","fc[k]=f_c","C[k]=C_F","L[k]=L_F","Rl[k]=R_LF","Ri[k]=R_i","Kv[k]=K_v","v[k]=v_out","io[k]=i_out","il[k]=i_LF"],"states":["zr[k]","zi[k]"],"outputs":["ILF_REF=I","LF*dILF_REF/dt (literalportlabel)=D","V_CTRL=V"],"differential_equations":["zr[k+1]=r[k]","zi[k+1]=I[k]"],"algebraic_equations":["ev=v-r","c=Kv*ev","I=io+fc*C*(r-zr)-c","D=fc*L*(I-zi)","ei=il-I","V=D+Rl*I+r-Ri*ei"],"notes":"zr,zi are unit-delay memories storing the previous reference r and current reference I. All ten input ports, including coefficient ports fc,C,L,Rl,Ri,Kv, are external current-sample signals and may vary with k. Unindexed algebraic quantities use sample k; initial memories are arbitrary. D is the implemented finite difference fc*L*(I-zi), despite its derivative port label. The selected implicit-ground interpretation sets the final summer's unconnected negative input to zero; Kv*(v-r) enters only the current-reference summer. The equations are discrete updates."}

annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Current PI controller","Converter lag","Second-order current plant","Current-feedback filter"],"inputs":["r_a=i_ds* or i_qs*"],"states":["xi_a","j_a","i_a","v_a","m_a"],"outputs":["i_a=i_ds or i_qs"],"differential_equations":["dot(xi_a)=k_cp*e_a","dot(j_a)=(c_a-j_a)/T_s","dot(i_a)=v_a","dot(v_a)=(j_a-R_s*C*v_a-i_a)/(sigma*L_s*C)","dot(m_a)=(i_a-m_a)/T_cf"],"algebraic_equations":["e_a=r_a-m_a","c_a=i_dt* or i_qt*=xi_a+k_cp*tau_ci*e_a","y_a=i_a"],"notes":"a=d or q identifies one independent scalar-axis template. xi_a is PI integral contribution, j_a converter-lag current output, i_a plant current, v_a=i_a_dot a derivative coordinate rather than voltage, and m_a filtered current. The literal controller k_cp*(1+tau_ci*s)/s has integral coefficient k_cp and proportional coefficient k_cp*tau_ci. Require T_s*T_cf*sigma*L_s*C!=0. Supply five finite initial coordinates per instantiated axis; both axes use independent copies."}
